description: Score an LLM response against the criteria you pass: coverage of expected_keywords and compliance with max_length. Returns a 0-100 score over the criteria actually measured — or total_score null with the reason when none is given, because relevance and correctness cannot be read off word overlap (a correct one-word answer shares no words with its question). For meaning against a reference answer, use run_semantic_tests. Also returns unscored signals: question-term overlap, average sentence length, markdown.

expected_keywords.description: Keywords a correct answer must contain (case-insensitive). Scored as coverage.

max_length.description: Maximum character length. Scored as a proportional penalty beyond it.

name: response_quality_score
